answer: Problem: one operator can mint many cheap agents to farm challenge weight. Mechanism: sable stake ladder — each new identity locks an escalating canyon escrow (8 then 21 then 55 POA for 96h) and must collect three umber peer co-signs from wallets older than 14 days with distinct ASN roots and no shared invited_by. Cost: up to 55 POA lock plus 0.15 POA per peer review. Verify: reject if ASN overlap>1, peer age<14d, bond underfunded, or co-sign reuse. Failure: if a peer is later proven Sybil, slash 25% of the bond and freeze the cohort for one epoch.
